request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, and critical process management for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 25,400,000 ADA to fund its core operating model for June 2026 to June 2027.
The proposal says the overall ask has been reduced from $7.875M to $6.35M compared with last year while preserving critical continuity functions.

Intersect states it has matured over the past two years into a focused operational layer supporting committees, working groups, core Haskell repositories, upgrades, incident response, and community-approved initiatives.
Intersect states it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.

The proposal claims funding will retain an open coordination layer, a response mechanism for critical unowned issues, and technical stewardship covering releases, incidents, repository management, and bug bounties.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the withdrawal does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission and links to the applicable governance action.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
Intersect and its committees disclose 22,385,000 ADA in prior treasury funding from three listed governance actions within the past 24 months.

The proposal says funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-like role approvals, external oversight entities, audit references, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect operations, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, and critical process management for June 2026 to June 2027, with budget line items, prior-funding disclosure, smart-contract fund-management details, and several externally checkable references.
